meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Remove AI-generated code smells (slop) from branch changes or an explicit file list. Locks behavior with regression tests FIRST, then runs categorized cleanup via parallel `deep` agents in batches of 5, then verifies with quality gates. Covers 10 slop categories including performance equivalences, excessive complexity (object annotations, if/elif variant chains), and oversized modules (250+ pure LOC with mandatory modular refactoring). MUST USE when the user asks to "remove slop", "clean AI code", "deslop", "clean up AI-generated code", "remove AI slop", or wants to clean up AI-generated patterns from recent changes. Triggers - "remove ai slops", "clean ai code", "deslop", "cleanup AI generated", "remove AI slop", "clean up AI-generated code", "strip slop", "ai-slop cleanup".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检测并清理AI生成的代码坏味道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要清理AI助手生成的冗余或低效代码
copy.tagline_en: Automatically detect and clean AI-generated code smells
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to clean up redundant or inefficient code from AI assistants

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会先为改动补回归测试锁定行为,再分类清理AI代码异味(多余注释、死代码、重复代码、超大模块等),最后跑质量门验证;失败就回退或直接改。
howto.when: 当你说“remove slop”“clean AI code”“deslop”等,要求清理AI生成的代码模式时触发;或要求清理最近改动中的AI痕迹时也会触发。

say.text: 把当前分支改动里的AI代码异味清理掉
say.note: 会先补回归测试锁定行为,再分批清理

say.text: 对 src/a.py 和 src/b.py 执行 deslop 清理

say.text: 清理最近改动中AI生成的过度复杂代码
say.note: 会按类别处理,复杂度过高的会重构

howto.what_en: After install, Claude locks behavior with regression tests, then cleans AI slop by category (comments, dead code, duplication, oversized modules...), then verifies via quality gates; on failure it reverts or edits directly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'remove slop', 'clean AI code', 'deslop', etc., or ask to clean up AI-generated patterns from recent changes.

say_en.text: Clean the AI code smells from the current branch changes.
say_en.note: It locks behavior with tests first, then cleans in batches.

say_en.text: Run deslop on src/a.py and src/b.py.
say_en.note: Only those files; tests first, then cleanup.

say_en.text: Clean up overly complex AI-generated code in recent changes.
say_en.note: It handles categories; complex code gets refactored.
